import json

# Read the file
with open('apps/web/locales/en-US.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Add new keys to workspace.settings.api_keys (the nested api_keys under workspace.settings)
# The keys go after \"api_key\" in alphabetical order
api_keys_section = data[\"workspace\"][\"settings\"][\"api_keys\"][\"api_keys\"]

# Keys to add (in alphabetical order):
# \"api_key_rotated\": \"API key rotated\"
# \"delete_api_key_confirmation\": already exists
# \"key_rotated\": \"Key rotated\"
# \"key_rotated_description\": \"...\"
# \"last_used\": \"Last used\"
# \"never_used\": \"Never used\"
# \"rotate\": \"Rotate\"
# \"unable_to_rotate_api_key\": \"Unable to rotate API key\"

new_keys = {
    \"api_key_rotated\": \"API key rotated\",
    \"key_rotated\": \"Key rotated\",
    \"key_rotated_description\": \"Update the secret for this API key. The old secret will stop working immediately.\",
    \"last_used\": \"Last used\",
    \"never_used\": \"Never used\",
    \"rotate\": \"Rotate\",
    \"unable_to_rotate_api_key\": \"Unable to rotate API key\",
}

# Insert in alphabetical order
inserted = []
for key, value in new_keys.items():
    # Find the right position (after the key that would come before it alphabetically)
    before_key = None
    for existing_key in api_keys_section.keys():
        if key > existing_key:
            before_key = existing_key
    
    # Build new ordered dict
    new_section = {}
    inserted.append(key)
    first = True
    for ek in api_keys_section.keys():
        if ek == before_key and first:
            new_section[key] = value
            first = False
        new_section[ek] = api_keys_section[ek]
    if first:
        new_section[key] = value
    
    api_keys_section = new_section

data[\"workspace\"][\"settings\"][\"api_keys\"][\"api_keys\"] = api_keys_section

# Write back
with open('apps/web/locales/en-US.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    f.write('\\n')
